hero.title: Excellence in Technical Inspection and Industrial Safety
hero.subtitle: We ensure the integrity and efficiency of your projects with the highest corporate and regulatory standards.

about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Committed to technical excellence and operational safety in every project we lead.
about.card1_text: To provide specialized technical consulting services, ensuring compliance with quality standards, safety, and applicable regulations at every stage of our clients' projects.
about.card2_text: To establish ourselves as the reference company in industrial technical consulting in Paraguay, recognized for the soundness of our criteria and our positive impact on safety and productivity.
about.card3_text: Technical Rigor · Integrity and Objectivity · Commitment to Safety · Operational Excellence. Principles that guide every opinion and report we issue.

services.title: Our Services
services.subtitle: Specialized technical solutions executed with international quality and precision standards.
services.s1_text: Rigorous technical control of assemblies in complex industrial plants, ensuring precision and specification compliance at every phase.
services.s2_text: Strict monitoring of technical installations to ensure maximum quality and operational efficiency under precise specifications.
services.s3_text: Comprehensive control of regulatory compliance in industrial safety to safeguard the integrity of people, assets, and productive processes.
services.s4_text: Technical and documentary validation of installed structures in accordance with design specifications and applicable regulations.
services.s5_text: Preparation of detailed technical reports, expert opinions, and supporting documentation for audits and regulatory inspections.
services.cta_text: Contact us to assess your technical requirements and receive a tailored proposal.

why.title: Why Choose Us
why.subtitle: Over a decade of industry experience backs us up.
why.card_text: Our reports and opinions are completely objective and impartial. We work with total independence from contractors and suppliers, ensuring the objectivity of every assessment.
why.f1_text: We apply methodologies and international standards at every assessment, from planning to final report delivery.
why.f2_text: We deliver detailed technical reports, inspection protocols, and photographic evidence supporting each issued opinion.
why.f3_text: Agile operational capacity for projects throughout Paraguay with competitive response times.
